changes.before: The present second and third singular have i. The preterite contrasts singular æ with ǣ in the second singular and plural, and changes ð to d. Retain the lexical prefix ge-.
changes.after: The present second and third singular have i. In the preterite, first and third singular gecwæð retain æ and ð; second singular gecwǣde and plural gecwǣdon have ǣ and d. Retain the lexical prefix ge-.

changes.before: The bracket replaces the infinitive “to see” with a purpose clause, “that they might see”; use the appropriate subjunctive. The rank comparison after ofer is dative as Cook §166 directs.
changes.after: The bracket replaces the infinitive “to see” with the finite clause “that they might see”, expressing what they desired under gewilnodon. This desired-content clause takes the subjunctive (Cook §194.b). The rank comparison after ofer is dative as Cook §166 directs.

changes.after: The spirits of the storms fulfil his word. The plural subject takes dōð; keep this fulfilment sense of dōn distinct from a general act of making.
